paragraphs.source_en: But just as Mototsugu was about to lead his troops toward Kokubu, a mounted scout arrived with a report.

units.source_en: But just as Mototsugu was about to lead his troops toward Kokubu, a mounted scout arrived with a report.
units.source_zh: 然而，基次正欲率军朝国分进发时，接到探马来报。

paragraphs.source_zh: 然而，基次正欲率军朝国分进发时，接到探马来报。

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord, I have a report! The enemy vanguard has already reached Kokubu, some two or three thousand strong. From what I observed, they are Mizuno Katsushige’s troops.”

units.source_en: “My lord, I have a report!
units.source_zh: “禀报大人！

units.source_en: The enemy vanguard has already reached Kokubu, some two or three thousand strong.
units.source_zh: 敌军先锋已经到达国分，兵力约两三千。

units.source_en: From what I observed, they are Mizuno Katsushige’s troops.”
units.source_zh: 据小人观察，乃是水野胜成部。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “禀报大人！敌军先锋已经到达国分，兵力约两三千。据小人观察，乃是水野胜成部。”

paragraphs.source_en: It was the height of the sweltering season, yet the waters of the Ishi River, flowing quietly through the morning mist, were cool and refreshing.

units.source_en: It was the height of the sweltering season, yet the waters of the Ishi River, flowing quietly through the morning mist, were cool and refreshing.
units.source_zh: 时下正是酷暑季节，但在晨雾中静静流淌的石川之水却很是清凉。

paragraphs.source_zh: 时下正是酷暑季节，但在晨雾中静静流淌的石川之水却很是清凉。

paragraphs.source_en: “Once we cross the River of Three Crossings, we can fight the enemy to our hearts’ content!” Mototsugu commanded. Without a trace of fear or hesitation, he surged forward, crossed the river, and swiftly seized Komatsuyama. From there, a headlong descent eastward down the slope would carry them straight into the enemy camp arrayed to the east.

units.source_en: “Once we cross the River of Three Crossings, we can fight the enemy to our hearts’ content!”
units.source_zh: “渡过了三途川，就可与敌军放手一搏！”

units.source_en: Mototsugu commanded.
units.source_zh: 基次吩咐。

units.source_en: Without a trace of fear or hesitation, he surged forward, crossed the river, and swiftly seized Komatsuyama.
units.source_zh: 他无一丝畏惧，毫不犹豫往前冲，渡河之后，迅速占领了小松山。

units.source_en: From there, a headlong descent eastward down the slope would carry them straight into the enemy camp arrayed to the east.
units.source_zh: 从此地沿山坡朝东直奔而下，可直杀进敌军布于东面的阵营。

paragraphs.source_zh: “渡过了三途川，就可与敌军放手一搏！”基次吩咐。他无一丝畏惧，毫不犹豫往前冲，渡河之后，迅速占领了小松山。从此地沿山坡朝东直奔而下，可直杀进敌军布于东面的阵营。

paragraphs.source_en: The sky gradually brightened. From the summit, the Eastern Army’s banners could be seen moving along the highway toward Kokubu—the enemy had begun its advance. By the ordinary principles of warfare, Mototsugu should have waited there for the forces behind him; Sanada Yukimura and Mōri Katsunaga had even visited his camp expressly to urge him to do so. But Mototsugu had no intention of remaining. A veteran of many campaigns, he knew perfectly well that events had already passed beyond Yukimura’s and Katsunaga’s control.

units.source_en: The sky gradually brightened.
units.source_zh: 天色渐明。

units.source_en: From the summit, the Eastern Army’s banners could be seen moving along the highway toward Kokubu—the enemy had begun its advance.
units.source_zh: 从山顶可见，东军的旗帜正在前往国分的大道上移动——敌军已经开始行动。

units.source_en: By the ordinary principles of warfare, Mototsugu should have waited there for the forces behind him; Sanada Yukimura and Mōri Katsunaga had even visited his camp expressly to urge him to do so.
units.source_zh: 根据用兵常识，基次应该在此地等待后军，真田幸村和毛利胜永也曾专为此事到军营一访。

units.source_en: But Mototsugu had no intention of remaining. A veteran of many campaigns, he knew perfectly well that events had already passed beyond Yukimura’s and Katsunaga’s control.

units.source_zh: 但基次已无意在此停留，久经沙场的他十分清楚，情势已非幸村与胜永可掌控。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天色渐明。从山顶可见，东军的旗帜正在前往国分的大道上移动——敌军已经开始行动。根据用兵常识，基次应该在此地等待后军，真田幸村和毛利胜永也曾专为此事到军营一访。但基次已无意在此停留，久经沙场的他十分清楚，情势已非幸村与胜永可掌控。

paragraphs.source_en: In Mototsugu’s judgment, once Ieyasu had executed Kimura Sōki for his failed attempt to set fire to Nijō Castle and Kyoto, he would certainly not linger in the capital. That being so, the battlefield would not be confined to the Yamato approach; anyone might stumble into an encounter with the great Kantō army advancing along that route.

units.source_en: In Mototsugu’s judgment, once Ieyasu had executed Kimura Sōki for his failed attempt to set fire to Nijō Castle and Kyoto, he would certainly not linger in the capital.

ja.t: くとどまるはずはなかった。

units.source_zh: 根据基次的判断，家康处决在二条城与京都纵火未遂的木村宗喜之后，断不会滞留京都。

units.source_en: That being so, the battlefield would not be confined to the Yamato approach; anyone might stumble into an encounter with the great Kantō army advancing along that route.
units.source_zh: 如此一来，战场就不只在大和口，谁都可能和沿着大和口而来的关东大军发生遭遇战。

paragraphs.source_zh: 根据基次的判断，家康处决在二条城与京都纵火未遂的木村宗喜之后，断不会滞留京都。如此一来，战场就不只在大和口，谁都可能和沿着大和口而来的关东大军发生遭遇战。

paragraphs.source_en: Yet even if Sanada or Mōri fought shoulder to shoulder with Mototsugu, the outcome would not change in the slightest. Whether they wished it or not, in today’s battle every allied contingent could do no more than fight desperately wherever it encountered the enemy and leave the outcome to heaven.

units.source_en: Yet even if Sanada or Mōri fought shoulder to shoulder with Mototsugu, the outcome would not change in the slightest.
units.source_zh: 但即便真田或毛利同基次并肩作战，结局也不会有任何改变。

units.source_en: Whether they wished it or not, in today’s battle every allied contingent could do no more than fight desperately wherever it encountered the enemy and leave the outcome to heaven.

ja.t: まざるとにかかわらず、

units.source_zh: 不论愿意与否，今日这场战争，己方各军只有在哪里遭遇敌人，便在哪里奋力厮杀，听天由命。

paragraphs.source_zh: 但即便真田或毛利同基次并肩作战，结局也不会有任何改变。不论愿意与否，今日这场战争，己方各军只有在哪里遭遇敌人，便在哪里奋力厮杀，听天由命。

paragraphs.source_en: Gotō Matabee Mototsugu understood his present situation only too well. Seeing enemy troops climbing toward the summit one after another, he ordered his men to raise a mighty battle cry. It was a bold act utterly heedless of the consequences.

units.source_en: Gotō Matabee Mototsugu understood his present situation only too well.
units.source_zh: 后藤又兵卫基次对目下的处境甚是明白。

units.source_en: Seeing enemy troops climbing toward the summit one after another, he ordered his men to raise a mighty battle cry.
units.source_zh: 见敌军陆陆续续爬往山顶，他令众人放声呐喊。

units.source_en: It was a bold act utterly heedless of the consequences.
units.source_zh: 这乃是不顾后果的大胆之举。

paragraphs.source_zh: 后藤又兵卫基次对目下的处境甚是明白。见敌军陆陆续续爬往山顶，他令众人放声呐喊。这乃是不顾后果的大胆之举。

paragraphs.source_en: When the shouts rang out from Komatsuyama, Okuda San’emon Tadatsugu, a retainer of Mizuno Katsushige, was climbing the mountain with sixty or seventy men, intending to seize the summit and gain the advantage of the terrain.

units.source_en: When the shouts rang out from Komatsuyama, Okuda San’emon Tadatsugu, a retainer of Mizuno Katsushige, was climbing the mountain with sixty or seventy men, intending to seize the summit and gain the advantage of the terrain.
units.source_zh: 听见小松山上的呐喊时，水野胜成属下的奥田三右卫门忠次正带着六七十人爬山，试图占领小松山，以获地势之利。

paragraphs.source_zh: 听见小松山上的呐喊时，水野胜成属下的奥田三右卫门忠次正带着六七十人爬山，试图占领小松山，以获地势之利。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ah! Someone is shouting!”

units.source_en: “Ah! Someone is shouting!”
units.source_zh: “啊，有人呐喊！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “啊，有人呐喊！”

paragraphs.source_en: “The summit has already been taken!”

units.source_en: “The summit has already been taken!”
units.source_zh: “已有人占领了山头！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “已有人占领了山头！”

paragraphs.source_en: “They are not the enemy. They must be Hori’s or Niwa’s men. Forward!” At the head of the column, Okuda San’emon Tadatsugu raised his spear high and shouted to his men. At that moment, the men on the summit charged down with a roar, like fierce tigers descending a mountain.

units.source_en: “They are not the enemy. They must be Hori’s or Niwa’s men.
units.source_zh: “不是敌军，许是堀或丹羽的军队。

units.source_en: Forward!”
units.source_zh: 前进！”

units.source_en: At the head of the column, Okuda San’emon Tadatsugu raised his spear high and shouted to his men.
units.source_zh: 队伍最前面的奥田三右卫门忠次高举长枪，对手下士众大喊。

units.source_en: At that moment, the men on the summit charged down with a roar, like fierce tigers descending a mountain.
units.source_zh: 此时，山顶的人呐喊着冲了下来，有如猛虎下山。

paragraphs.source_zh: “不是敌军，许是堀或丹羽的军队。前进！”队伍最前面的奥田三右卫门忠次高举长枪，对手下士众大喊。此时，山顶的人呐喊着冲了下来，有如猛虎下山。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ah! The enemy! It is the enemy!” San’emon stumbled to the ground in astonishment, and the host pouring down from the summit, with Mototsugu at its head, swept over him like an avalanche.

units.source_en: “Ah!
The enemy!
units.source_zh: 敌人！

units.source_en: It is the enemy!”
units.source_zh: 是敌人！”

units.source_en: San’emon stumbled to the ground in astonishment, and the host pouring down from the summit, with Mototsugu at its head, swept over him like an avalanche.
units.source_zh: 三右卫门在惊讶中摔倒在地，从山顶冲下来的大军，以基次为首，排山倒海般从他身上碾过。

paragraphs.source_zh: “啊！敌人！是敌人！”三右卫门在惊讶中摔倒在地，从山顶冲下来的大军，以基次为首，排山倒海般从他身上碾过。

paragraphs.source_en: This was the first encounter of the Summer Campaign. Gotō’s force of more than a thousand charged fiercely down from the summit. Okuda’s men collapsed in an instant, leaving only seven or eight corpses tumbling down the slope like stones.

units.source_en: This was the first encounter of the Summer Campaign.
units.source_zh: 此乃夏役首次遭遇战。

units.source_en: Gotō’s force of more than a thousand charged fiercely down from the summit. Okuda’s men collapsed in an instant, leaving only seven or eight corpses tumbling down the slope like stones.
units.source_zh: 后藤的一千多人马从山顶奋力冲下，奥田军眨眼间溃去，只剩下七八具尸体，如石头般扑棱棱滚落下去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此乃夏役首次遭遇战。后藤的一千多人马从山顶奋力冲下，奥田军眨眼间溃去，只剩下七八具尸体，如石头般扑棱棱滚落下去。

paragraphs.source_en: On reaching the level ground below, Okuda’s men frantically searched for their commander, but Okuda Tadatsugu was already dead. He lay on the ground beside a blood-smeared spear, already lifeless. A stab wound remained in his lower belly, and his whole body had been trampled into a ghastly state.

units.source_en: On reaching the level ground below, Okuda’s men frantically searched for their commander, but Okuda Tadatsugu was already dead.
units.source_zh: 到了山下的平地，奥田士众慌忙寻找主将的身影，但是奥田忠次已不在世上了。

units.source_en: He lay on the ground beside a blood-smeared spear, already lifeless. A stab wound remained in his lower belly, and his whole body had been trampled into a ghastly state.
units.source_zh: 他躺在地上，身旁扎着沾满血污的长枪，早已断了气，小腹还留着被刺伤的痕迹，全身为人踩踏，惨不忍睹。

paragraphs.source_zh: 到了山下的平地，奥田士众慌忙寻找主将的身影，但是奥田忠次已不在世上了。他躺在地上，身旁扎着沾满血污的长枪，早已断了气，小腹还留着被刺伤的痕迹，全身为人踩踏，惨不忍睹。

paragraphs.source_en: Having routed Okuda’s force in a single stroke, Mototsugu led his men back to the summit.

units.source_en: Having routed Okuda’s force in a single stroke, Mototsugu led his men back to the summit.
units.source_zh: 一举击溃了奥田军，基次率军回到了山顶。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一举击溃了奥田军，基次率军回到了山顶。

paragraphs.source_en: It was now broad daylight. Atop the mountain, Mototsugu leisurely ate the rice ball in his hand as he watched the course of battle below. Along the highway, across the fields, and on the riverbanks at the foot of the mountain, troops seething with murderous intent were everywhere.

units.source_en: It was now broad daylight.
units.source_zh: 天已大亮。

units.source_en: Atop the mountain, Mototsugu leisurely ate the rice ball in his hand as he watched the course of battle below.
units.source_zh: 基次在山顶悠悠吃着手里的饭团子，看着山下的战势。

units.source_en: Along the highway, across the fields, and on the riverbanks at the foot of the mountain, troops seething with murderous intent were everywhere.
units.source_zh: 山脚的大道、农田与河岸上，到处都是杀气腾腾的人马。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天已大亮。基次在山顶悠悠吃着手里的饭团子，看着山下的战势。山脚的大道、农田与河岸上，到处都是杀气腾腾的人马。

paragraphs.source_en: Mizuno Katsushige was a commander personally appointed by Ieyasu and a warrior of great courage. At the hour of the Ox that day, he saw torches moving along the road to Fujiidera and immediately concluded, “It must be Gotō Matabee!” He then ordered Hori Naoyori and Niwa Ujinobu to send men to investigate.

units.source_en: Mizuno Katsushige was a commander personally appointed by Ieyasu and a warrior of great courage.
units.source_zh: 水野胜成乃是家康亲点的指挥将领，也是勇猛之士。

units.source_en: At the hour of the Ox that day, he saw torches moving along the road to Fujiidera and immediately concluded, “It must be Gotō Matabee!”
units.source_zh: 是日丑时，他见通往藤井寺的路上有火把移动，立即判断：“必是后藤又兵卫！”

units.source_en: He then ordered Hori Naoyori and Niwa Ujinobu to send men to investigate.
units.source_zh: 然后，便令堀直寄和丹羽氏信派人前去打探。

paragraphs.source_zh: 水野胜成乃是家康亲点的指挥将领，也是勇猛之士。是日丑时，他见通往藤井寺的路上有火把移动，立即判断：“必是后藤又兵卫！”然后，便令堀直寄和丹羽氏信派人前去打探。

paragraphs.source_en: “So they have indeed chosen this place as their battlefield! It was because the Shogun and the Ōgosho foresaw exactly this that they dispatched troops through the Kawachi approach. Tonight the Shogun will reach Chizuka, and the Ōgosho will arrive at Hoshida. Within the next five or six days, we shall be able to settle the issue with the enemy once and for all.”

units.source_en: “So they have indeed chosen this place as their battlefield!
units.source_zh: “他们果然选择此地作为战场！

units.source_en: It was because the Shogun and the Ōgosho foresaw exactly this that they dispatched troops through the Kawachi approach.
units.source_zh: 将军大人和大御所正是如此预料，才出兵河内口。

units.source_en: Tonight the Shogun will reach Chizuka, and the Ōgosho will arrive at Hoshida.
units.source_zh: 今夜，将军便会到达千冢，大御所抵星田。

units.source_en: Within the next five or six days, we shall be able to settle the issue with the enemy once and for all.”
units.source_zh: 接下来的五六日，便能与敌军一决胜负。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “他们果然选择此地作为战场！将军大人和大御所正是如此预料，才出兵河内口。今夜，将军便会到达千冢，大御所抵星田。接下来的五六日，便能与敌军一决胜负。”

paragraphs.source_en: The Kantō commanders believed the enemy had no choice but to intercept them here. Before the Yamato contingents came from Kōriyama and occupied Nara, both the Ōgosho and the Shogun had remained in Kyoto, considering how best to lure the enemy out of the castle. In that sense, the battlefield stretching from Dōmyōji to Yao and Wakae had in fact been chosen by the Eastern Army as well.

units.source_en: The Kantō commanders believed the enemy had no choice but to intercept them here.
units.source_zh: 关东认为，敌人只有选择此处拦截他们。

units.source_en: Before the Yamato contingents came from Kōriyama and occupied Nara, both the Ōgosho and the Shogun had remained in Kyoto, considering how best to lure the enemy out of the castle.

units.source_zh: 大和各部从郡山前来、占据奈良之前，大御所和将军都留在京城，考虑如何诱敌出城。

units.source_en: In that sense, the battlefield stretching from Dōmyōji to Yao and Wakae had in fact been chosen by the Eastern Army as well.
units.source_zh: 从这个意义上来说，从道明寺到八尾、若江的战场，其实亦是东军所选择。

paragraphs.source_zh: 关东认为，敌人只有选择此处拦截他们。大和各部从郡山前来、占据奈良之前，大御所和将军都留在京城，考虑如何诱敌出城。从这个意义上来说，从道明寺到八尾、若江的战场，其实亦是东军所选择。
